platform: KEXP Music Department Digital Airplay Submission Email Route
manual_review_reason: KEXP accepts digital releases at md@kexp.org, but final delivery requires a human to select a suitable MarcsMusic release, verify ownership and release status, prepare streaming and WAV download links without attachments, supply the requested credits, focus tracks, lyric sheet, bio and clean edits where required, approve all personal data and send the email. KEXP receives high submission volume, cannot guarantee spins or a reply, and editorial review must not be automated.

platform: KUTX Music Director On-Air Rotation Submission Email Route
manual_review_reason: KUTX accepts mastered new or upcoming releases through music@kutx.org, but a human must confirm track and programme fit, verify rights and release status, prepare an approved streaming link and downloadable WAV link without MP3 attachments, provide the required bio, location, release notes and clean radio edit where necessary, select the top track when sending multiple songs, approve the pitch and personal data, and send the email manually. Editorial consideration and any specialist-show outreach cannot be automated.
